# Semantic-aware Decoding for Diverse Text-to-SQL under Schema Ambiguity

[All reading notes](../reading-notes.md) · [Catalog entry](../README.md#semantic-aware-decoding)

**Full paper read · 2026-11-25**

[Original source](https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.30873v1) · arXiv:2611.30873v1, 23 November 2026; 8 pages.

**Reading coverage:** All 8 pages: Sections 1–6, Algorithm 1, equation and bound argument, Tables 1–3, Figures 1–5 and all references. All five figures and three result tables were visually inspected on PDF pages 2, 3, 6 and 7. This version has no appendices or separately linked supplement.

## Research question

Ordinary decoding can spend its candidate budget on variants of one schema mapping instead of covering alternative interpretations of an ambiguous request.

## Method

Tracks schema-element generation with a token prefix tree, masks invalid continuations, normalizes pairwise schema embedding similarities, and boosts alternatives by a fraction of the top-logit gap. SchemaBeam adds beam search, formatting-token masking and AST-based syntactic deduplication.

## Evaluation

Reports EitherInTop5 and BothInTop5 on 2,948 AmbiQT column/join/table cases and 373 AMBROSIA vagueness cases. A combined third interpretation is removed from some AMBROSIA references. Three base models are tested; sampling averages three runs. Relative latency is measured on two RTX A6000 GPUs.

## What the results support

BothInTop5 improves over vanilla beam in all reported model/category cells, but EitherInTop5 does not always improve. SchemaBeam is competitive with prompting and fine-tuning baselines at reported 1.1-times beam latency; some competing methods retain higher coverage on particular categories.

## Limits and qualifications

The benchmark subset and altered AMBROSIA references limit comparability with full-benchmark results. Schema similarity is a heuristic, and excluded ON/COUNT positions and structural errors remain outside the intervention. Logit access and valid token tracking are prerequisites. Some baseline backbones differ; no separate calibration split for the strength parameter, uncertainty intervals, user study or unanswerability test is reported. Public implementation and detailed reproducibility inputs remain unverified.

## Relevance to reliable Text-to-SQL

Direct schema-ambiguity candidate generation supporting later disambiguation, with reference coverage kept separate from intended-answer selection and dialogue success.
